lines.text: Your warmest jacket is the reason you're freezing on winter hikes.
You start in one big puffy coat.
On the climb, you sweat right through it.
Then the wind hits that wet shirt, and you're done.
The fix is thin layers. Base, fleece, shell. Keep the puffy in your pack for stops.
Warm and dry, the whole way up.
The Winter Hiking Guide shows what to wear at every temperature.
Get it at, hike supply co, dot com.
